note: Acceptance thresholds, reference anchors and the measured-regime classifier are fixed HERE, before any production run of this round. Nothing below may be tuned after inspecting results.

release_angle.formula: theta_d = arccos(-Fr)  [deg, measured from the 6 o'clock position]
release_angle.exactness: exact radial force balance N = m(omega^2 R + g cos theta) = 0 for a particle carried by the shell
release_angle.fr_limit: Fr >= 1 -> theta_d = 180 deg (load pinned, no release point)
release_angle.external_anchor: Haff 1983, JFM 132:401-430 (Froude-number similarity of rotating granular beds); identical expression in tensordem.drum_flow.regimes.detachment_angle_deg docstring

centrifuging_onset.exactness: exact: at Fr = 1 the normal force at the top of the shell vanishes (N = m(omega^2 R - g) = 0); for Fr > 1 no particle can leave the wall
centrifuging_onset.external_anchor: Haff 1983 JFM 132:401; classical Froude-number drum regime diagram

flow_regimes.diagram: sliding / surging / rolling / cascading / cataracting / centrifuging vs Fr = omega^2 R / g
flow_regimes.external_anchor: Mellmann 2001, Powder Technology 118:251-270 (transverse motion of solids in rotating cylinders)
flow_regimes.exactness: only the endpoints used here are exact (Fr -> 0 sliding, Fr = 1 centrifuging); intermediate bands are the literature's order-of-magnitude transitions and are used for QUALITATIVE labels only

measured_regime_classifier.note: independent of Fr; computed only from DEM observables. Fixed before the runs.

observables.r_p05_over_R: 5th percentile of r/R (annulus indicator; a pinned load has no particle near the axis)
observables.upper_flight_fraction: fraction of particles with zero contacts AND y > 0.15 R (ballistic flight above the centre)
observables.wall_velocity_ratio: mean tangential speed of the wall layer / (omega R)

directional_predictions.claim: wall_velocity_ratio increases with Fr (the load couples to the shell as the Froude number grows)
upper_flight_fraction increases with Fr (ballistic throwing appears as Fr -> 1)
r_p05_over_R increases with Fr and jumps at Fr >= 1 (pinned annulus)
measured wall-contact-arc upper end follows theta_d = arccos(-Fr) within 20%
the segregation metric S(rev) reaches a plateau; a short window is not accepted as evidence of a steady state

acceptance.quantitative: P4 relative error < 20% at every Fr < 1 with a finite release angle; centrifuging onset Fr_c within 20% of 1
acceptance.qualitative: P1-P3 signs as predicted; P5 plateau demonstrated at two revolution counts
acceptance.honesty: any failed prediction is reported as failed; no threshold is changed after the runs

amendment_1.reason: the 6 mm (N=581) bed could not be brought to the frozen rest criterion (rms < 5e-3 m/s) within 20 quench rounds with the shipped bed-preparation protocol; the 10 mm (N=209) bed reaches it. Production runs therefore use d_small = 10 mm and the 6 mm case is reported as an open limitation.
amendment_1.changed: main runs and sensitivity runs use d_small = 0.010 m
amendment_1.unchanged: all reference anchors, thresholds, classifier rules and predictions
